title: Review: entire usenet-ipfs project
notes: Confidence: 70% chance of missed bug. Uncertainty driven by: (1) transit backfill is stubbed — the actual peer-to-peer block fetch path is unwritten and cannot be reviewed; (2) JMAP Email/query filter logic not tested against a real JMAP client; (3) Sieve execution semantics depend on sieve-rs runtime behavior not reviewed here; (4) TLS state machines in reader and smtp were reviewed at the session level but not the tokio-rustls integration. Would raise confidence with: integration tests covering the reconcile-then-backfill loop end-to-end, and a live JMAP client (Thunderbird or Fastmail web) exercising the mail crate.
